title: LA Sports Daily Digest ??? 15-Minute Edition
intro: Happy Sunday, LA: the Dodgers have ripped off four straight wins behind Tarik Skubal's 11-strikeout statement start and a nine-game NL West cushion, USC's Playoff-or-bust Trojans are one week from kickoff in Lincoln Riley's most hyped season yet, and Sean McVay's Rams just hung a 34-0 preseason shutout on the Saints with Myles Garrett anchoring a loaded defense. From Chavez Ravine to the Coliseum to SoFi Stadium, it doesn't get much better than this. Here's everything you need to know today.
intro_zh: 洛杉矶的球迷们，周日快乐：道奇队凭借斯库巴尔11次三振的宣言级先发豪取四连胜，国联西区已领先9场；南加大特洛伊人在林肯·莱利任内最受期待的"非季后赛不可"赛季开球前只剩一周；而麦克维麾下的公羊刚在季前赛以34比0零封圣徒，迈尔斯·加雷特领衔的豪华防线蓄势待发。从道奇体育场到纪念体育场再到SoFi球场，作为洛杉矶体育迷，没有比这更美好的时刻。以下是今天你需要知道的一切。

segments.headline: Skubal's 11-strikeout statement caps a four-game surge as the Dodgers' loaded rotation finally assembles for October
segments.headline_zh: 史庫博（Tarik Skubal）11次三振宣告王牌本色，道奇四連勝、國聯西區領先9場，豪華輪值終於在十月前集結完成
segments.analysis: The deadline blockbuster paid off Saturday: Tarik Skubal shook off a three-run first and retired 18 of his final 19 Pirates, fanning 11 over seven innings while Kyle Tucker snapped an 0-for-26 skid with the go-ahead single in a 4-3 win — LA's fourth straight. The timing matters because the rotation is suddenly whole: Tyler Glasnow returns Tuesday in Atlanta with no pitch limit, joining Yamamoto, Snell, Sasaki and Skubal in a six-man look. Shohei Ohtani threw 30 pitches in his first live BP and could be on a mound in games by early September, while Will Smith began facing live pitching with a September activation targeted. The catch: All-Star center fielder Andy Pages fractured his hand Friday and is out at least four weeks, thinning an outfield exactly when the lineup can least afford it. With a nine-game cushion over San Diego, the Dodgers' October ceiling now hinges less on health than on how quickly this star-studded pitching machine finds playoff rhythm.
segments.analysis_zh: 交易大限的重磅補強週六收到成效：Tarik Skubal首局失三分後迅速回穩，後續19個出局數解決18人，七局飆出11次三振，加上Kyle Tucker打破26打數無安打的低潮、五局上擊出超前二分安打，助道奇4比3逆轉海盜拿下四連勝。此刻的關鍵在於輪值終於齊整——Tyler Glasnow週二在亞特蘭大歸隊且不受球數限制，與Yamamoto、Snell、Sasaki和Skubal組成六人輪值。Shohei Ohtani已完成復出後首次30球的實戰牛棚練投，最快九月初就能登板，Will Smith也開始面對實戰投球，目標九月歸隊。隱憂則是明星中外野手Andy Pages週五被觸身球造成左手骨折，至少缺陣四週，讓外場深度在最不該出問題的時候亮起紅燈。手握九場勝差優勢，道奇的十月上限已不再取決於健康，而在這台星光熠熠的投球機器能否及時找到季後賽節奏。

segments.headline: Playoff-or-bust: Riley's highest-hyped USC team opens at No. 14 with Patterson's defense holding the keys.
segments.headline_zh: 季前排名第14，USC迎來Riley時代第五季：成敗繫於Patterson的防守改造與Maiava的爭冠野心。
segments.analysis: Preseason No. 14 USC kicks off Aug. 29 against San Jose State with national-QBR-leader Jayden Maiava back and Hall of Famer Gary Patterson overhauling a defense that collapsed in the big games last year. The schedule is brutal — five preseason top-25 foes including No. 1 Ohio State and No. 2 Oregon at the Coliseum, plus a Nov. 14 trip to defending champion Indiana. The wild card is up front: season-ending center Kilian O'Connor's injury forces Tobias Raymond into a position switch just weeks before kickoff. Lincoln Riley is 42-0 when allowing 20 or fewer points, so if Patterson's "more bodies to the ball" scheme actually travels from camp to Saturdays, this roster is playoff-caliber. Year 5 was always going to be judgment time in Los Angeles — and this fall delivers the verdict early.
segments.analysis_zh: 第5年的Lincoln Riley帶著隊史最高規格陣容開季：上季全國QBR第一的Jayden Maiava回歸，名人堂防守協調員Gary Patterson則要修補去年在關鍵戰崩盤的防線。賽程堪稱地獄級——五場對上季前Top 25，包括主場迎戰No. 1 Ohio State與No. 2 Oregon，11月14日還要遠征衛冕冠軍Indiana。最大變數在鋒線：先發中鋒Kilian O'Connor整季報銷，Tobias Raymond必須在開季前倉卒換位。Riley生涯在失分20分以內的比賽是42勝0負，若Patterson強調「更多人圍堵持球者」的新體系能從訓練營延續到正式比賽，這支球隊絕對有晉級College Football Playoff的實力。第五年就是驗收年，而答案很快就會揭曉。

segments.headline: Garrett-era defense announces itself with 34-0 preseason blanking of Saints as reloaded Rams eye historic Melbourne opener
segments.headline_zh: Garrett 領銜防線 34 比 0 零封聖徒，重裝上陣的公羊劍指墨爾本歷史性開幕戰
segments.analysis: The Rams suffocated New Orleans 34-0 at SoFi Stadium behind Alex Cook's 100-yard pick-six, an Al'zillion Hamilton interception and Wesley Bailey's sack-plus-forced-fumble, all with newly acquired superstar Myles Garrett anchoring the edge while reigning MVP Matthew Stafford rested per Sean McVay's standing preseason policy. All-Pro Puka Nacua sat out with psoas soreness but is expected back for Week 1, and his new agency hire signals extension talks are coming fast off his league-leading 129-catch, 1,715-yard season. Stetson Bennett IV strengthened his grip on the QB2 job with two rushing scores, holding off rookie first-rounder Ty Simpson. With the 49ers awaiting at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Sept. 10 in the first NFL regular-season game ever played in Australia, this shutout is proof the Rams' all-in roster is built to contend immediately.
segments.analysis_zh: 公羊在 SoFi Stadium 以 34 比 0 完封聖徒：Alex Cook 百碼抄截回攻達陣、Al'zillion Hamilton 攔截、Wesley Bailey 製造掉球，新王牌 Myles Garrett 坐鎮衝傳，而衛冕 MVP Matthew Stafford 依 Sean McVay 慣例整個熱身賽休兵。全職業外接手 Puka Nacua 因腰肌痠痛缺練，但可望第 1 週歸隊；他此時聘請經紀公司，顯示繼上季 129 次接球、1,715 碼的聯盟頂尖表現後，續約談判即將啟動。Stetson Bennett IV 兩度衝刺達陣，穩住二號四分衛位置，頂住首輪新秀 Ty Simpson 的強勢挑戰。9 月 10 日公羊將前進墨爾本板球場出戰 49 人，寫下 NFL 例行賽首次登陸澳洲的歷史，這場零封正是宣告：全隊壓注的奪冠窗口就在當下。

closing: That's the day in LA sports: the Dodgers keep rolling with Glasnow and Ohtani on the way, the Trojans are counting down to Saturday night at the Coliseum, and the Rams look every bit a Super Bowl contender bound for Melbourne. See you tomorrow, Los Angeles.
closing_zh: 这就是今天的洛杉矶体育：道奇队乘胜追击、格拉斯特诺和大谷即将回归，特洛伊人正在为周六晚的纪念体育场揭幕战倒计时，而剑指墨尔本的公羊队已然尽显超级碗竞争者本色。明天见，洛杉矶。
